groups.why: All three check the same thing on the Main Grid while text is typed into the search conditions (Model, Owner, etc.): before the search button is pressed, the grid must not redraw or move.

Both check the same grid with the same condition (Customer FCST Upload, Sales Monitoring, Business Plan, Sales Plan) and expect only zero redraw or flicker; they don't check movement, so they are kept apart from the first group.
This row also expects text conditions to work regardless of case and covers lowercase input and top-grid scrolling, so it does not match the others and stays on its own.
